name: Methylsulfonylmethane (MSM)
short: A review describes few known and mild side effects; a 16-week placebo-controlled trial found no changes in blood, liver or kidney tests. Long-term safety is unconfirmed.
text: A review reported that MSM is well tolerated by most people at up to four grams daily, with few known and mild side effects. In a safety analysis of a 16-week randomised placebo-controlled trial, blood counts, liver and kidney tests, weight and blood pressure did not differ between MSM and placebo. A pilot trial in knee osteoarthritis reported no major adverse events, and its authors noted that safety with long-term use could not be confirmed. No interaction data were found in the cited sources.
